tool_review.reason: Distinct requested task; structural checks and native model/covariate preparation make native RDS eligibility review useful without sampling.
tool_review.task: Check an occJSDM-ready RDS and covariate choices before fitting.
tool_review.primary_input: data_path plus explicit occupancy/collection covariate-name lists
tool_review.outputs: inferred model, structural dimensions and replication, missingness counts, traits availability/alignment, actionable issues and eligibility; no raw observation values
adaptations: Read native RDS and check exact info/OTU/traits components, matching dimensions and supplied row identifiers. Never reorder/repair input observations.
Use native inferDataModel and native covariate preparation; validation invariance checks prevent first-row selection masking within-unit conflicts.
Reject unsupported continuous/no-stage counts; preserve two_stage observation NA. Report absent traits as supported.
Path confinement and explicit species/trait identity requirements are classroom contract adaptations, not new scientific computations.

tool_review.reason: Requested nonspatial analysis using the existing public fitting API.
tool_review.task: Fit a supported nonspatial model and save a native result.
tool_review.primary_input: data_path, explicit seed, FitOptions with native covariate names, threshold, n_factors and MCMC settings
tool_review.outputs: fit_id, inferred model, settings/warnings and hashed fit.rds plus manifest
tool_review.source_section: Fit the model (adapt spatial example by leaving spatCovariates empty)
adaptations: Always spatCovariates=character(), summarisedLatentPresences=TRUE, upstream default listPriors; do not alter priors or sampler.
Explicit integer threshold>=1, nchain>=2, nburn>=0, niter>=1, nthin>=1, n_factors>=0; reject unknown or spatial options. These are pilot restrictions.
Use R set.seed(seed) before runOccJSDM; record input/source/runtime hashes, arguments and thread settings. Native niter is kept draws; total chain iterations nburn+niter*nthin.
Capture native messages/warnings, atomic successful artifact publication and read-back validation; bounded runtime must not shorten MCMC.

tool_review.reason: Separate post-fit task, bound to existing tidy native diagnostics.
tool_review.task: Inspect convergence for selected occupancy/detection coefficients.
tool_review.primary_input: server-owned fit_id and max_rows default 20, capped at 20
tool_review.outputs: bounded table, flagged/unavailable counts, complete diagnostics CSV and warning metadata
adaptations: Call returnConvergenceDiagnostics directly; no replacement Rhat/ESS computation.
Screen Rhat>1.01 and ESS<400 per approved teaching contract; preserve upstream warnings separately. Missing/nonfinite statistics serialize as JSON null and never count as convergence success.
Covers beta0_psi,beta_psi,beta_theta,p,q,theta0 where present, not every latent variable/assumption.

tool_review.reason: Requested compact interpretation of native baseline occupancy with diagnostic qualification.
tool_review.task: Summarise baseline occupancy draws and retain convergence qualifications.
tool_review.primary_input: server-owned fit_id and max_rows default 20, capped at 20
tool_review.outputs: bounded per-species baseline occupancy mean/median/95% interval, diagnostic counts/warnings, full summary CSV
tool_review.source_section: Look at the results; plotOccupancyRates delegates to returnOccupancyRates
adaptations: Call returnOccupancyRates directly; summarize columns using native R mean/quantile(.025,.5,.975), an explicit approved output adaptation.
Actual return is pooled draws x species (apply(...,1,c)), opposite the roxygen return description; verify orientation from direct execution, retain column species identifiers.

Baseline means logistic occupancy intercept, not site-level occupancy or observed detections. Integrate same native diagnostics table, beta limitations and explicit transport-only status for short fixtures.

tool_review.candidate: sampledata loading, RDS I/O, covariate design preparation
tool_review.reason: Prerequisites and validation internals, not independently exposed tools in four-tool scope.
Native fixture provenance; simulator tool deferred by approved scope.
Numeric baseline operation reused through returnOccupancyRates. No plot output selected.
runOccJSDM already invokes it. Preserve emitted warnings; do not add a fifth diagnostic tool or substitute console thresholds for approved screens.
Useful later teaching operations, excluded from current exact four tools. Scientific plot fidelity not applicable for this numeric pilot; do not claim benchmark-only plots as delivered outputs.

tool_review.candidate: spatial fitting, predictNewSites, ordination, residual associations, covariate/trait effects, latent-presence tables, variance partitioning, model selection
tool_review.reason: Outside current pilot; each future addition needs native reference and fresh verification. Current source has fixes newer than stale AGENTS history, so exclusions are scope decisions, not old bug claims.

tool_review.candidate: continuous fitting, raw-file conversion, unrestricted R execution
tool_review.reason: Explicit approved scope boundary; no fabricated replacement scientific algorithms.

verification_cases.procedure: Load package sampledata and sampleresults. Save sampledata unchanged as RDS. Call inferDataModel(sampledata), returnConvergenceDiagnostics(sampleresults), returnOccupancyRates(sampleresults) directly. Retain hashes, table and draw dimensions/names, warnings. Stored fit is reference postprocessing, not a fresh nonspatial fit.
verification_cases.compare: model two_stage; exact diagnostic columns/labels/NA; draws orientation discovered from actual native result; R mean and quantile(.025,.5,.975) summaries per species

verification_cases.procedure: Source helper-fixtures.R after loading occJSDM. For binary, occupancy, two_stage use simulate_fixture(model=..., useSpatField=FALSE). Save data_list and true_params with source provenance. Fit with set.seed(explicit seed), spatCovariates=character(), listParams=list(n_factors=2), occCovariates=fixture_occ_covariates(), MCMCparams=FIXTURE_MCMC, summarisedLatentPresences=TRUE. Collection X_theta can be included explicitly after confirming its exact generated column name.
verification_cases.compare: model and n/species dimensions; B0 shape [S,20,2]; diagnostics block coverage; direct-vs-wrapper same-runtime outputs for same inputs/settings/seed; no scientific recovery claim

verification_cases.procedure: Use native alignment_samples and alignment_data helpers, without executing test_that sections. Global/local/character sample IDs, unequal primer subsets and K, reverse paired info and OTU rows; use 20/20 schedule for MCP reference while preserving fixture data. Verify native preparation before fitting wrapper.
verification_cases.compare: X_theta rows follow typed Site,Sample order; M=(2,2,2), K=(2,1,3,1,2,2,1,2,1); idx_w_k tracks original sample blocks; preserve OTU pairing. Occupancy local sample IDs are a separate inference boundary, not guaranteed success.

verification_cases.procedure: Native generated fixture with traits removed; categorical trait data from smoke test; trait rows permuted with species rownames intact; select one occupancy/collection covariate; rename a covariate and pass the renamed name; collCovariates Site,Sample using alignment fixture.
verification_cases.compare: native no-traits route and reordered-by-name Tr; correct expanded design-column labels; missing selected names error; identifier collection covariates remain valid

verification_cases.procedure: Run same fixed data and explicit seed twice, another seed once, nthin=2 with niter=10, requested threads recorded; execution references serialize fits.
verification_cases.compare: same-runtime seed replay; kept-draw count niter, not niter/nthin; total per chain nburn+niter*nthin; thread reproducibility only if tested

verification_cases.procedure: Independently probe malformed RDS object, wrong dimensions, missing/duplicate species names, missing/duplicate trait names, absent covariate, conflicting covariates per Site or Site+Sample, NA covariates/IDs, nonfinite observations, unsupported no-stage counts/continuous. Separately probe NA OTU in two_stage vs occupancy/binary, missing two_stage Primer, occupancy local sample IDs, binary unique explicit Site in unsorted order, niter=1 and one species/no covariates/zero-column traits.
verification_cases.compare: capture actual native errors/outcomes; validation must expose limitations without silently repairing observations or implementing new diagnostic math. Constant-chain Rhat must remain unavailable.
